snippet.title: Realization - concept trailer 视觉小说恐怖游戏 -《变现》首支预告
snippet.description:
AP工作室制作的视觉小说恐怖游戏《变现》的首个预告片。
Realization is my first indie game in the horror visual novel genre.
Agaze Productions is a studio dedicated to make dark narrative adventure games.
